title: Count the licenses before the portal

beats.say: Penny wants a portal where partners find her APIs. By Friday, naturally.
Archie suggests API Experience Hub. MuleSoft runs it, but every portal lives on Experience Cloud.
beats.speaker: archie

beats.say: So count seats first: at least two thousand External Identity licenses.
Missing prerequisites love to fail mid-linking. Penny's Friday depends on it.

facts.claim: Every API Experience Hub portal runs on Salesforce Experience Cloud.
facts.evidence: every portal it creates runs on Salesforce Experience Cloud

facts.claim: API Experience Hub requires at least 2,000 External Identity licenses.
Missing prerequisites tend to surface as failures during Salesforce linking.
facts.evidence: Missing prerequisites tend to surface as failures during Salesforce linking
